days.title: Tokyo at an easy pace
days.notes: Settle in with a short neighborhood walk and an unhurried first meal. Demo adapted from Lonely Planet Japan (19th ed., 2026). Dates, transfer choices, travel times and prices are illustrative; nothing is booked. Per-person inputs: €45/day living, €60/night room share, plus listed transport. Arrival and onward travel are excluded.

days.title: Old streets and the river
days.notes: Explore Asakusa, then follow the Sumida waterfront. Leave time for small shops and an afternoon break.

days.title: A different side of Tokyo
days.notes: Mix a garden or gallery with the streets around Shibuya. Keep the evening flexible before moving west.

days.title: West to Kyoto
days.notes: Travel to Kyoto and get to know the lanes near your base. Keep the first afternoon light.

blocks.notes: Shinkansen journey; rounded planning time includes reaching the station and settling into Kyoto.

days.title: Temple lanes and river paths
days.notes: Spend the morning in Higashiyama, then slow down beside the Kamo River. Choose a few stops and walk between them.

days.title: Gardens and a free afternoon
days.notes: Give Kyoto a third day for a garden, a craft shop and whichever neighborhood deserves a second look.

days.title: Nara for the day
days.notes: Visit Todaiji and wander through Nara Park. Return to the same Kyoto base for the night.

blocks.notes: Regional train to Nara; allow time to reach the temple and park district.
Return to Kyoto after the visit; no hotel change today.

days.title: Himeji Castle, then Hiroshima
days.notes: Break the westbound journey at Himeji. Leave several hours for the castle before continuing to Hiroshima.

blocks.notes: Rail journey and local access to the castle; sightseeing time is separate.
Continue by shinkansen after the castle visit; Hiroshima is tonight's base.

days.title: A full day in Hiroshima
days.notes: Give the Peace Memorial Museum and park an unhurried visit. Leave the rest of the day for the riverside and a local meal.

days.title: Miyajima and the Inland Sea
days.notes: Cross to Miyajima for Itsukushima Shrine and the waterfront. Return to Hiroshima, where this ten-day plan ends.

blocks.notes: Travel via Miyajimaguchi and its short ferry crossing. Estimate includes local connections and boarding.
Return to Hiroshima after the island visit. Travel home or onward is outside this demo.
